name: Ramp open graph social card by ramp.com
description: A 1200×630 social card that works like a product collage rather than a billboard: the black wordmark anchors the empty left third, a large dark credit card with concentric-line texture forms the focal centre, and a right rail of small app UI vignettes (transaction row, stacked-area chart, reimbursement pill, spending progress) plus a currency-conversion chip fill the frame with believable product evidence. Hierarchy is built by scale contrast — one hero object, then small tiles at decreasing importance — while a warm light-grey canvas, white tiles and sparse yellow/green accents keep the busy composition calm. Type is a single grotesque sans used at drastically different sizes, from display wordmark down to 11px UI labels.
